abstract: PURPOSE: To present a case of struma ovarii with a typical features and synchronous primary thyroid carcinoma and review the available literature to guide diagnosis and management of these tumors. METHODS: We present a case from our hospital of a 55-year-old woman who had an adnexal mass with features concerning for papillary thyroid carcinoma and was ultimately determined to be struma ovarii with atypical features. Subsequent thyroid imaging and biopsy revealed a primary cervical thyroid carcinoma. We performed a PubMed search of published English language articles using the search terms "malignant struma ovarii," "metastatic struma ovarii," "struma ovarii with malignant transformation," "struma ovarii papillary thyroid carcinoma," "struma ovarii follicular thyroid carcinoma," and "struma ovarii with concurrent primary thyroid carcinoma." RESULTS: Literature review included 104 studies with a total of 195 patient cases. The average age at presentation was 44.9 years. 25.1% of patients had metastatic disease at presentation, and 6.2% had synchronous primary carcinomas; all of which were located in the thyroid. CONCLUSIONS: Thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii or mature cystic teratoma should prompt clinical evaluation and imaging of the thyroid given the possibility of synchronous primaries, metastases, and recurrence.
abstract_ja: 目的：典型的ではない特徴を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫と同時性原発甲状腺癌の症例を報告し、これらの腫瘍の診断および管理の指針とするため、利用可能な文献をレビューすること。方法：当院で経験した、乳頭状甲状腺癌が疑われる付属器腫瘤を有する55歳女性の症例を提示する。最終的に、非典型的特徴を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。その後の甲状腺画像検査および生検により、原発性の頸部甲状腺癌が認められた。「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」「転移性卵巣甲状腺腫」「悪性転化を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫」「卵巣甲状腺腫 乳頭状甲状腺癌」「卵巣甲状腺腫 濾胞性甲状腺癌」「卵巣甲状腺腫 併発原発性甲状腺癌」を検索語として、PubMedで英語論文を検索した。結果：文献レビューでは104編の研究、計195例の患者が含まれた。診断時の平均年齢は44.9歳であった。患者の25.1%が診断時に転移性疾患を有し、6.2%が同時性原発癌を有していた。これらはすべて甲状腺に発生していた。結論：卵巣甲状腺腫または成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた甲状腺癌では、同時性原発癌、転移、再発の可能性を考慮し、甲状腺の臨床的評価および画像検査を行うべきである。
